builds.hypothesis:
Fiora identifies Vitals on enemy champions. Hitting this Vital with an Attack or Ability deals an additional [0.03 + (0.0004) × AD[statFormula=2]] max Health true damage, grants Fiora @spell.FioraR:PercentMS*100@% Move Speed decaying over [2] seconds, and restores [characterLevelInterpolation(35 → 100; raw flags preserved)] Health.

Fiora reveals a new Vital after 15 seconds or after striking one.
Bloodthirster/Eclipse supply AD; Sterak AD must be read live; Heartsteel/Titanic health feeds Bloodmail AD. No armor penetration is credited to true packets. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers. Override: Shadowflame replaces Eclipse because its explicit 20% amplification below 40% target HP supports true damage. Its AP and magic penetration do not increase the true packet coefficient (except Shyvana bite AP); compare retained Eclipse at 100% target HP.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability max rank; minute 30, no external ally buffs or dragons, 3000 max-HP target with 1500 bonus HP, 100 armor/50 MR and 29% starting HP unless objective overrides. Heartsteel exactly 500 earned HP if present; self 10% HP for Bloodmail. Seraph earned from fully stacked Tear. Rune gathering time fixed at 30min; item combat ramps ready.

testPlan: Finite benchmark: Level 18, selected ability max rank; minute 30, no external ally buffs or dragons, 3000 max-HP target with 1500 bonus HP, 100 armor/50 MR and 29% starting HP unless objective overrides. Heartsteel exactly 500 earned HP if present; self 10% HP for Bloodmail. Seraph earned from fully stacked Tear. Rune gathering time fixed at 30min; item combat ramps ready.

Strike one vital on fixed-HP target, excluding base attack and item on-hits. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The initial form fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR); adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Stored helper/statFormula or symbolic fields remain unresolved: validate live stat meanings/tick rules, do not silently infer. Unbounded earned stacks imply no finite global maximum; this entry uses the stated finite benchmark. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Bloodthirster, Sterak's Gage, Overlord's Bloodmail, Heartsteel, Titanic Hydra, Shadowflame. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
coverageNotes: These targets are manual experiments. Existing Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W numeric adapters cannot certify these whole loadouts, omitted item/rune effects or global maxima.
